name: Supertrend ATR-trailing trend (Pine import)
rationale: Faithful import of the classic Supertrend trend-follower (KivancOzbilgic's open-source SuperTrend STRATEGY; Alorse 'Supertrend [Alorse]', ATR period 10 / multiplier 3.7). Supertrend is an ATR-scaled trailing line: it flips bullish when price closes above the upper band and rides an ATR-distance trailing stop until price closes through it. Economic mechanism: an ATR-normalized trailing stop only stays on the right side of price while a directional trend persists, so being long while the line is bullish harvests trend-persistence (the same autocorrelation-of-returns premium momentum exploits) while the ATR trail cuts the position the moment the trend structurally breaks — volatility-adaptive risk, wide in chop, tight after a clean run. We translate the Supertrend STATE to an enabled long: positive medium-term return (ret_Nd>0, price above the implied trailing line) confirmed by an ADX floor (Supertrend whipsaws badly in non-trending tape — the directional-strength filter is the honest stand-in for 'a real flip, not noise'), and we ride it with the defining piece of Supertrend — an ATR-scaled trailing exit (exit.plan.runner_trail) armed after the first take-profit, with break-even protection. Translation losses (noted, not fabricated): (1) Supertrend's exact recursive band/flip line is not a registry feature — approximated by ret_Nd>floor + adx>floor on a fitted lookback that the Finder matches to the intended ATR window; (2) the literal ATR-multiplier-3.7 trailing distance becomes a fitted runner_trail fraction (no magic number); (3) the lowest(2)-bar initial stop becomes a fitted stop fraction. Honest prior: Supertrend is the most-cloned crypto trend script but in spot backtests net of ~20bps round-trip it usually reduces to a fee-eaten momentum proxy — expected outcome is a powered fail that maps the ATR-trail surface; the Gate disposes. Disconfirmer: ADX collapsing below a floor (trend died) closes the trade before the trailing stop, and the time-stop bounds a stalled flip.
catalyst: Supertrend flips/stays bullish — price holds above its ATR-trailing line in a confirmed (ADX) trend
